pins.name: GPIO0
pins.label: GPIO0 (Button)
pins.notes:
Must be HIGH or floating for normal boot; LOW at boot enters flash/programming mode. No interrupt support. This board's onboard CONFIG/FUNCTION pushbutton (K1), pulled to GND when pressed — schematic-confirmed, see pfodWeb NOTE above
Onboard CONFIG/FUNCTION pushbutton (K1) — active-low, schematic-confirmed, see pfodWeb NOTE above

pins.name: GPIO1
pins.label: GPIO1
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 TX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO

pins.name: GPIO2
pins.label: GPIO2 (Led active low)
pins.notes:
Must be HIGH at boot. This board's onboard (blue) LED — active-low, driven via a 1k resistor from 3V3 (D4/R21) — schematic-confirmed, see pfodWeb NOTE above
LED_BUILTIN — onboard blue LED, active-low (schematic-confirmed, see pfodWeb NOTE above)

pins.name: GPIO3
pins.label: GPIO3
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 RX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes: RTC-domain pin: no internal pull-up/down, no PWM, no interrupt support. Commonly wired to RST for deep-sleep wake

pins.name: A0
pins.label: A0 (GPIO17)
pins.notes: Analog input only (A0) — cannot be used for digital I/O or PWM. This board's Grove analog port has an onboard 220k/180k resistor divider ahead of it — see adc note below and pfodWeb NOTE above
